decisionsTitle: The list for sponsors, behind a notice that says the partners may receive it; the public-list tick names the results; the «Acorduri» block compacted (amending §562 and §143)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-09-29 18:40–18:42:** «I need to be able to export the participants list but filter out just the ones who agreed to receive marketing emails so we can share it with our sponsors.» And: «"Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți — opțional" => "Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate — opțional" cuz we will also have a results list.» **At 19:03**, of a screenshot of the form's «Acorduri» block: «Also these need to be more compacted!» **Amends §562** (its notice said «Le trimite numai clubul: partenerii nu primesc adresa ta»; the fold on «Newsletter»), **§143** (the tick's words) and **§550** (the same readers).

**The list for sponsors.** One read, `registrations/sponsor-list.ts#readPromoConsentRows`, is the only query of who said yes to «oferte și beneficii»: a yes (`promo_consent`) on a real registration (`kind` in no other condition, AGENTS.md §12.6) whose address is proved and which still stands — waiting for its declaration, on the waiting list, offered a place, or confirmed (§562's `PROMO_LISTED_STATUSES`, now defined there and re-exported by the newsletter) — never an unproved address, a cancelled, an expired or a test registration. `sponsorList({ eventId? })` narrows it to what a partner may receive and is read by both doors: «Descarcă lista pentru sponsori» on an event's registrations page (with an event chosen) and the same button inside «Newsletter» → «Participanți care au bifat oferte și beneficii» for every event. One file, `buildSponsorListCsv`: Prenume, Nume, Email, Eveniment, Data acordului (ISO 8601) — never the birth date, the phone, the health note, the declaration's facts or the address holder's other people — through `csvCell`, CRLF, a BOM; named `sponsori-<slug-evenimentului>-<zi>.csv` or `sponsori-toate-<zi>.csv`. The route `GET /api/admin/registrations/sponsor-list?event=<id>` (no event = every event; an id that is not a UUID is 400) asserts `canExportSponsorList` — `canReadRegistrations`: the Organizer, the Administrator, the Superadministrator; Tehnic, the volunteer, the Redactor and a member are refused (403) whatever the link — and writes one audit row `registrations.sponsor_list_exported` with `{ eventId | null, count }`, never a row. The count sits beside the button («N persoane», `countForm`), with one caption: what the file holds, to note whom it is given to and to delete it within 30 days. The main registrations export is untouched: the sponsor list is its own minimal file. §562's club list on «Newsletter» keeps its table and its «Descarcă CSV» in their place, read through the same query and written by the same writer (its CSV has the five columns now), because the club's own sending is covered by every yes, the partners' only by some.

**The gate (AGENTS.md §10.8, the §396/§562 mechanism).** A new merge field `{{promotionalMaterialsShared}}`, filled with the three data a partner receives in words («prenumele, numele și adresa ta de e-mail» / “your first name, last name and email address”, `Registration.promo.sharedData`), read by `describesPromotionalMaterialsShared`. `{{promotionalMaterials}}` stays the box itself, exactly as §562 reads it; the box's words do not change. The button is offered only while the notice in force names the new field in every language (`noticeDescribesPromotionalMaterialsShared`); otherwise it is a disabled button with «Nota de confidențialitate în vigoare nu spune că lista poate fi dată partenerilor.» and the route answers 409 — the page's state is the same rule, not the rule. And the list holds only the registrations whose yes was given under a text that described the sharing: `domain/sponsor-share.ts#sharedWithSponsors` asks **both** the notice the registration recorded (`privacy_notice_version`) **and** the notice in force at `promo_consent_at` (a later yes from the person's own page is given under the notice of that moment, §562) to be in the exact set of approved, not withdrawn versions that name the field in every language (`findSponsorShareVersions` — a set, not §421's lower bound, so a later version that drops the marker never lets its registrants through). A yes given under §562's «partenerii nu primesc adresa ta» never reaches a partner, even once a sharing notice is in force; a person who registered under it and said yes later under the new one is left out too, the safe side. No migration: the columns exist.

**The notice template** (both languages; the twelve sections kept; the four placeholders untouched; no text in effect changes — production keeps its approved notice until the club approves one from the template). Section 5: §562's «Le trimite numai clubul: partenerii nu primesc adresa ta…» is gone, and a paragraph «Lista pentru parteneri:» says the club may give its partners — the club's sponsors and the partners of its events, named as a category — `{{promotionalMaterialsShared}}`, so they send their own offers; nothing else; never sold; the consent covers the club's messages and the partners'; a partner uses the data as a separate controller under its own notice and may be asked directly to stop; the list is given only with consents given under a version that says so; a withdrawal stops every later sharing and the club asks the partners that hold the data to stop writing and delete it; art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and art. 12 of Law 506/2004; on request the club says which partners received the data (art. 15, 19); the complaint to ANSPDCP (section 9). Section 6: «Nu le vindem și nu le dăm nimănui altcuiva, cu o singură excepție…» names the partners and the field. Section 7: «Lista dată partenerilor: copia clubului, ștearsă în cel mult 30 de zile de la descărcare; la partener, cât spune nota lui de informare, iar când îți retragi acordul îi cerem să îți șteargă datele.» The template's header says what changed; `/admin/legal` sees the moved template by its hash (§532) and says «Nota în vigoare nu spune încă că lista pentru sponsori…» (`legal.sponsorMissing`); the legend lists the field; `/admin/tasks` carries the open, never blocking row `sponsorNotice` with the steps, done by itself the day such a notice takes effect.

**What the person reads.** On the manage page and «Înscrierile mele», a registration whose yes may reach a partner reads «La această înscriere primești oferte și beneficii de la club și de la partenerii săi. Clubul le poate da partenerilor prenumele, numele și adresa ta, ca să îți scrie ei.» (`Registrations.promo.yesShared`); every other yes keeps §562's sentence, still true for it.

**The tick's words (amending §143).** «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate — opțional» / “I want to appear on the participants & results list — optional”, the ampersand as the owner wrote it, wherever the tick is named: the form, the manage page's and «Înscrierile mele»'s switch («Vreau / Nu vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate»), the confirmation email's link, the staff form («Persoana vrea să apară pe lista de participanți & rezultate»), the event list's note and the editor's help, AGENTS.md and BUSINESS.md. The notice's section 4 quotes the new words and its results sentence names one disclosure behind one tick: «Rezultate cu nume nu publicăm încă. Când le vom publica, vor apărea în ele doar cei care au bifat aceeași „vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate” — o singură bifă pentru listă și pentru rezultate, pe care o retragi la fel — iar această notă va spune dinainte ce arată rezultatele.» — replacing «te vom întreba separat», which contradicted the tick's new words. No FAQ template names the tick; the guide does not quote it.

**«Acorduri», compacted.** `shared/ui/consent-density.ts#CONSENT_DENSITY`, read by `CheckboxField`'s `dense`, by `ReadAndAgree` and by the density test: MUI's small box (20 px) with `CHECKBOX_TAP_TARGET`'s 12 px around it — 44 by 44, still the thumb's target (BR-REQ-041-01 criterion 6), where the medium box was 48; the label in `body2`, top-aligned, 12 px above and below; the block its own `Stack` with no gap. A row is `max(44, 24 + 20 × lines)` px, where it was `max(48, 24 × lines) + 16`: five one-line rows are 220 px where they were 304, and every line of the block is 20 px where it was 24. Each helper — the list's states, the socials', the offers' «Opțional…» — is a caption directly under its label, 4 px below the words, and the box's `aria-describedby`. The race's conditions are a regular-height button (44 px, `TAP_TARGET`) with the book glyph, as wide as its words, the small box inside it, and its hint a caption; the gate is unchanged — unread, a press on the box opens the text and does not tick it (§195, §422). No word the legal reviews fixed (§425, §556) changed; the terms sentence stays one flow, its version and clauses inline.

**Refused.** Adding the sponsor columns to the registrations export (a file that leaves to a third party must hold the minimum, art. 5(1)(c)). A lower-bound version gate (§421's documented hole). Giving a partner a yes given under §562's text, even "only the names". Renaming `{{promotionalMaterials}}` or changing the box's words (texts the club may already have approved). A separate consent box for the sharing: the owner asked for one list of those who agreed, and the notice now says the one box covers both; the box's own sentence already names «partenerii săi». Recording which partner received a file in the application: the club knows whom it sends it to; the guide and the caption tell it to note that, and the audit row says a file was made.
changelogLine: - **«Descarcă lista pentru sponsori»** — on an event's registrations page and on «Newsletter» for every event: first name, last name, email, event and consent date of those who said yes to «oferte și beneficii» under a privacy notice that says partners may receive them (the new template's `{{promotionalMaterialsShared}}`), Organizer and Administrator only, every download audited; the public-list tick reads «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate — opțional»; the form's «Acorduri» block is about half as tall. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given registrations that said yes to offers and benefits, when «Descarcă lista pentru sponsori» is downloaded for one event (`GET /api/admin/registrations/sponsor-list?event=<id>`) or for every event (no `event`), then both come from the one query and the one CSV — Prenume, Nume, Email, Eveniment, Data acordului, a BOM, CRLF, every cell neutralized, named `sponsori-<slug>-<day>.csv` or `sponsori-toate-<day>.csv` — holding only real registrations whose address is proved and which still stand, never a no, a cancelled, an expired, an unproved-address or a test registration, and never the birth date, the phone, the health note or the declaration's facts; each download writes one audit row `registrations.sponsor_list_exported` with the event (or null) and the count, never a row (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the sponsor list, when it is read or its route is asked, then the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator receive it, and Tehnic, a volunteer, the Redactor and a member are refused on the server (FORBIDDEN / 403) and a signed-out request gets 401, whatever the page drew (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the platform's privacy-notice template, when it is read in either language, then section 5 no longer says the partners never receive the address and a paragraph «Lista pentru parteneri» / “The list for partners” names `{{promotionalMaterialsShared}}` (filled with the first name, the last name and the email address), the partners as a category, never sold, one consent for the club's and the partners' messages, a withdrawal that stops every later sharing with the partners told to stop, the basis, the recipients on request and the complaint; section 6 names it as the one exception; section 7 carries its retention; the four placeholders and the twelve sections are kept; `{{promotionalMaterials}}` is unchanged (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the privacy notice in force, when it does not name `{{promotionalMaterialsShared}}` in every language, then «Descarcă lista pentru sponsori» is a disabled button with «Nota de confidențialitate în vigoare nu spune că lista poate fi dată partenerilor.», the route refuses the file (409) and writes no audit row, and `/admin/tasks` shows the open row `sponsorNotice` with the steps; and when it does, the list holds only a yes whose recorded notice version and whose notice in force at `promo_consent_at` are both approved versions naming the field — a yes given under a notice that said the partners receive nothing is never listed (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event that publishes its list, when the registration form, the manage page, «Înscrierile mele», the confirmation email or the staff form names the public-list tick, then it reads «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» / “I want to appear on the participants & results list” (the form adds «— opțional»), and the privacy notice's section 4 quotes the same words and names the list and the results as one disclosure behind one tick (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the registration form, when its «Acorduri» block renders, then it is its own stack with no gap between rows, every box in it is MUI's small box at 44 by 44 pixels with its label in body2 (a one-line row 44 px, a row `max(44, 24 + 20 × lines)` px), each helper line is a caption under its label that describes the box, and the race's conditions are a regular-height button with the book glyph that still opens the text before its box can be ticked — with every word of the terms, fitness and privacy ticks unchanged (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the list for sponsors behind a notice that says so; the list tick names the results; «Acorduri» compacted
